entities.summary: Abd al-Aziz al-Fishtali, fully Abu Faris 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Sanhaji al-Fishtali was a Maghrebi writer, head of the chancery, official historiographer, and official poet of the Saadi Sultan Ahmad al-Mansur.
